summary: This directory provides the central service and entry point for application configuration resolution. It coordinates the retrieval, validation, and merging of settings from global, user, and scope-based sources into a strongly typed structure.
responsibilities: Provide a unified entry point for resolving application configurations
Combine configuration values from multiple hierarchical sources
Apply validation logic to ensure configuration integrity
Expose interfaces for specifying configuration resolution criteria
Manage the lifecycle of configuration resolution through dedicated services
relationships: The resolution service consumes configuration criteria to determine which scopes and functions should be applied during the retrieval process.
The integration of multiple configuration sources is facilitated by the resolution service, which applies precedence and merging rules to create a coherent result.
Validated, strongly typed results are returned to the application based on the criteria specified in the resolution query.
designDecisions: Usage of the Service pattern to provide a consistent configuration resolution API
Strong typing for resolution criteria and resulting configuration objects
Layered architecture separating high-level service requests from internal loading and merging strategies
Provision of a live service implementation as a dependency injection layer
